absent: Transmit datapath, receive buffer refill and polling logic outside routed line ranges.
Control queue command wire format, timeout handling and error recovery beyond success indication.
Receive side scaling table programming, key handling and hash type negotiation details.
Page pool creation parameters, DMA mapping lifetime and destroy paths.
Failover device creation semantics and receive mode work scheduling triggers.
Guest offload control values and hardware GRO interaction beyond toggle handling.
Device statistics capability layout and statistics query completion.
XDP program install preparation before completion tail and socket pool setup internals.
Virtqueue discovery, interrupt allocation and queue stop start sequencing.
Link settings update routine invoked on link up.
Remainder of probe after statistics capability query start, including error unwind and remove paths.

findings.text: Packet filter operation entry accepts only program configuration and zero copy pool configuration requests, dispatching each to its own routine and treating any other request as invalid.
Physical port naming succeeds only when standby feature is present, reporting sby, otherwise unsupported, including insufficient caller space.

Hardware generic receive offload toggling is refused while packet filtering is active; otherwise guest offload state is reprogrammed through the control path and the stored copy is updated only on success.
Receive hash toggling rewrites the stored hash type selection to either the saved set or none, then commits through the control path, with commit failure reported as invalid.
Transmit timeout handling increments a per queue timeout counter under sequence protection and emits a diagnostic identifying queue, virtual queue and elapsed idle time.
Interrupt moderation initialization requests receive profiling with time and packet coalescing using a fixed period mode, then applies default moderation settings to every receive queue.
Interrupt moderation teardown is skipped without per queue coalescing capability, otherwise it serializes moderator release with routing table lock held.
Feature checking for encapsulated packets clears checksum capabilities when the packet is not segmentation offloaded or still needs segmentation, leaving other packets unchanged.

Driver exposes a full network device operations set covering transmit, redirect transmit, socket wakeup, open and close, address handling, receive mode, statistics, virtual LAN management, filter attach, feature audit and update, physical naming and timeout.

Configuration change handling first serves peer announcement when status capability allows, then tracks link state; unchanged state is ignored, link up triggers settings refresh plus carrier on and queue wake, link down triggers carrier off and queue stop.
Device configuration change notification only schedules deferred processing and returns immediately.

Filter update completion always resumes reception and reenables transmission with proper reference handling, while failure paths restore prior programs and offload state before resuming and adjust accounting accordingly.
Receive buffer release drains all queued pages per queue and detaches any installed packet filter program with reference drop.
Bulk receive buffer release runs with global routing configuration lock held to serialize against filter program lookup.
Send queue cleanup for an idle virtual queue resets transmit bookkeeping for the corresponding network queue.
Driver provides a read only per receive queue attribute reporting the current mergeable buffer length computed from headroom, shared info tail space and packet length estimator.
Mergeable receive attributes are collected in a single entry table terminated by null and exposed as a group under the driver short name.
Mergeable buffer size query enforces that the caller queue index lies within configured pairs and traps otherwise, so callers must never pass foreign queues.
Feature dependency check logs when a capability is advertised without its prerequisite and reports failure, otherwise it reports success without side effects.

Feature validation requires control queue presence whenever multiqueue, scaling, hash reporting, receive control, virtual LAN control, media address control, peer announcement or any coalescing capability is present.
Lower device MTU limit follows Ethernet minimum and upper limit follows Ethernet maximum.
Device validation rejects missing configuration access and invalid feature combinations, silently drops undersized MTU advertisement and drops standby advertisement without media address support.
Feature clearing removes a single feature bit from device feature storage through the shared bit helper.
Shared feature bit clearing affects only recognized bit positions and preserves all other bits in the hosting word.
Sixteen bit configuration read may sleep and returns host order value converted from device endian format.
Guest segmentation capability is considered present when any IPv4, IPv6, congestion or legacy segmentation feature is present, with UDP segmentation requiring both address family variants together.

Large receive allocation is enabled when configured MTU exceeds standard payload or any guest segmentation is available, sizing fragment allowance for worst case segmentation or for page count otherwise.
Hash report translation capacity is ten entries with out of range codes treated as none.
Hash report translation covers IPv6 extension variants, base IPv6 and IPv4, TCP and UDP combinations for each family, and a none value.

Zero copy metadata hash lookup requires receive hash offload, locates the device hash header before packet data using negotiated header length, clamps unknown report codes and returns both hash value and translated type.
Zero copy metadata operations expose only a receive hash callback.

Probe determines queue pair count from device maximum when multiqueue or scaling is present, otherwise single, falling back to single when out of allowed bounds or without control queue, and caps active pairs by online processor count.

Probed Ethernet device always enables high DMA, unicast filtering, live address change and no linear transmit handling, with bounded MTU, basic redirect and zero copy capabilities plus scatter gather when mergeable, and uses device media address when offered else a random one.

Checksum capability unlocks hardware checksum, scatter gather and tunnel segmentation options, with host segmentation variants mapped individually, robust segmentation always enabled, receive checksum always enabled and hardware generic receive offload enabled when guest TCP segmentation exists.
Scaling state records indirection size and key size clamped to driver maximum with warning on overflow, masks unsupported extension hash types, and enables receive hash plus metadata handling.

Negotiated header length prefers tunnel hash format when tunneling is present, then hash format with reporting, then mergeable or modern format, otherwise legacy base, with tunnel checksum, tunnel receive and transmit, and flexible layout flags derived separately.
Probe initializes control queue mutual exclusion before use and serializes registration plus early programming with global routing configuration lock to exclude concurrent open.
Device ready is signalled only after successful registration with change notifications held off until open, after which queues are activated.
Device MTU shrinking between validation and probe is treated as fatal probe error rather than silent clamp.
Scaling commit failure during probe disables receive hash and reporting capabilities with a warning while allowing the device to remain usable.
Coalescing defaults start with zero time and packet thresholds, with transmit packet threshold chosen according to transmit polling weight, both globally and per queue.

Guest offload capabilities are collected from advertised device features into stored and capable copies, enabling hardware generic receive offload advertisement when control and GRO related bits allow.

Probe establishes page pools, per queue moderation when supported, receive queue sysfs grouping for mergeable mode, true queue counts, default scaling and receive mode handling, plus failover linkage when standby is present, aborting probe on creation failure.
